cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Help Me Make This Normal
cards.instruction: Get someone to help perform the strange behavior until it feels ordinary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Pass the talking cupboard a napkin. Let's make dinner normal.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then put it beside the handle, like a considerate host.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Please. Ask which shelf it eats from. We can't keep making our guest explain everything.
